article_being_kind.summary: Kindness is a set of small actions, not a special kind of person. After reading this, you can spot kindness in ordinary moments, welcome somebody who is left out, give a real compliment, and be kind to yourself on a hard day.
article_being_kind.title: Being Kind to Others

article_intelligence_illusion.summary: A grade, a certificate and a fast answer are proxies: cheap, standard stand-ins for ability. After reading this you can name what a score really measures, separate evidence from the conclusion drawn from it, compare six kinds of evidence from weak to strong, and use six steps to judge ability from real work instead of from a label.
article_intelligence_illusion.title: The Illusion of Intelligence: When a Grade Is Mistaken for Ability
